slides.title: Privacy Guard
slides.body: Before you share an ID, a form or a photo, Mochi finds what should stay private and covers it for good. All on your PC.
bullets: Aadhaar, PAN, phone, email, card and account numbers
Faces, QR codes, names and addresses
Looks again at the result to be sure nothing is left
slides.tip: Pick Privacy Guard in the donut. Check the boxes, drag to cover anything it missed.

slides.title: Updates come to you
slides.body: When a new Mochi is out, a small window now tells you what is new and installs it with one click.
bullets: Mochi checks when it starts and every few hours
You can turn the check off in Settings, General
